CP-NASA-SE.title: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook, Appendix G
CP-NASA-SE.use: Configuration-specific maturity, advancement difficulty and remaining development work; no generic TRL-to-duration conversion.

CP-ACLS.title: On-orbit Testing of the Advanced Closed Loop System ACLS, ICES-2020-510
CP-ACLS.use: ESA air-process heritage; three-crew configuration and shared-vent constraint at simultaneous four-crew operation; not current supply or lander qualification.

CP-AQUA.title: Climate science in orbit: Aquamembrane
CP-AQUA.use: Membrane water-processing experiment and ground/space technology route; reported two-year outlook is an expectation at publication, not current availability.

CP-WATER.title: Water Recovery in Space, ESA Bulletin 97
CP-WATER.use: Historical UF/RO route; three 100-hour runs, feed and water-quality limits. Not the same process as the FO hardware proxy.

CP-PCI.title: NASA report ICES-2024-156, CO2 conversion systems
CP-PCI.use: Reports a Sabatier development unit outside Europe; worldwide development alternative, not confirmed delivery.

CP-SOEC.title: High Pressure Water Electrolyser Development for Exploration Surface Missions, final presentation
CP-SOEC.use: SOEC breadboard route, feedthrough/separator limitations; not interchangeable with low-temperature cabin electrolysis.

CP-URINIT.title: Withheld in the public release (public document whose title names an organisation)
CP-URINIT.use: Laboratory urine-treatment route; about 75 percent RO-step recovery; mission calculation is not an endurance test. Optional scope only.

CP-BIOWYSE.title: BIOWYSE project 687447 results
CP-BIOWYSE.use: Monitoring/disinfection research and published methods; consortium membership is not complete-unit supply.

CP-PRIORITY.title: Rollock and Klaus, Functional prioritization strategies and tradespace considerations for a self-reliant deep space habitat
CP-PRIORITY.use: Function-criticality and Earth-dependence framing; no coefficients imported from unavailable full text.

CP-BIOCEME.title: Pilot Study on the Impact Assessment of ESA Early R&D Activities: Cellular Agriculture for Future Human Space Missions
CP-BIOCEME.use: Distinct ground/space routes and funding-dependent milestones; no food-system dates or costs transferred to ECLSS.
